Local browser utility for scanning and mapping font-family usage in exported Resolve DRP projects, including subtitle and Fusion-title data. Requires Python 3.10+ and a browser; launchers install dependencies. The creator reports Mac use but warns that Windows-created projects may crash. README claims MIT; no standalone license file was established.
